Maya: Heads-up — we have a group visit at 2:15pm: 6 students from the community art program. Front desk says they brought a stack of framed prints and three large flat cardboard art carriers. Need badge plan + seating? :paintbrush:
Front Desk: They arrived early, left parcels at reception. Labels say 'Art Class - Rm 102' and one box is unlabelled. I scanned ID pics for the lead teacher. Do we need to hold the unlabelled box? Also the lobby couch is reserved at 2pm by another visitor.
Sam: I'm at desk 4 — can move a spare chair to lobby. Also we have an extra folding table in storage B if needed.
Jules: @Front Desk please hold unlabelled box and ping me with a photo. We'll print temporary visitor QR badges at the kiosk. For seating, let's use the corner benches and the rumpus area — avoid the demo couch.
Front Desk: Photo attached: https://files.redwood/mockimage.jpg. Box is sealed, no carrier sticker. Teacher's name: Elena Vargas. She has a stack of consent forms.
Avi: I'll meet them at 2:10 and escort to the conference room. Can someone grab the box-tag kit? It's in cabinet 3, label `VIS-TAG-KIT`.
Sam: grabbing one of the folding chairs, bringing it to lobby now.
SecurityBot: Visitor check-in completed for Elena Vargas (ID scanned). Unlabeled package flagged for inspection. Please confirm disposal instructions.
Jules: Thanks all. @SecurityBot hold for inspection, do not open unless security on-site. Maya — do you want photos added to the visitor log?
Maya: Yes please. Add to log and attach photos. Also note: a courier (FedEx) dropped off a separate medium box with 'fragile' at 1:22pm; that's for DevRel — @Sam can you move to the mail shelf? :package:
Sam: moving it now — FYI it has 'DevRel swag' on the customs form.
Front Desk: All set. Visitors being led to CR-B. Badges printed with 'Art Class — Visitor'. Unlabeled box is tagged `HOLD-UNLAB-2247504321`.
Jules: Perfect. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
